'''''Yara's Fortune''''' was the private [[Starship/Legends|starship]] of famous [[Journalist/Legends|reporter]] [[Yara Grugara]] of the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. It was subsidized by [[Cularin Central Broadcasting]].
